Medium Affected: WATER

Report DescriptionTHE CALLER STATED THAT WHILE CONDUCTING EXCAVATION FOR A POOL AT THE LOCATION VARIOUS MATERIALS WERE UNEARTHED. THE MATERIALS IN QUESTION HAVE RELEASED INTO SOIL AND GROUND WATER AT THE LOCATION. BECAUSE OF THIS THE RESIDENCE AT THE LOCATION HAS BEEN ADVERSELY AFFECTED. THE SOURCE OF THE RELEASE IS UNKNOWN, HOWEVER THE CALLER SUSPECTS THE LOVE CANAL SUPERFUND SITE, WHICH IS (300) FEET FROM THE INCIDENT LOCATION. THE CALLER ALSO SUSPECTS A SECONDARY DUMP SITE THAT WAS DISCOVERED AT THE INCIDENT LOCATION TO BE A SOURCE OF THE RELEASED MATERIALS. THE AMOUNT OF MATERIAL THAT RELEASED IS UNKNOWN, HOWEVER THE CALLER STATED THAT THE DEC FILLED A 30-FOOT DUMPSTER OF AFFECTED SOIL. THE CALLER STATED THAT SAMPLES OF THE LOCATION HAVE BEEN TAKEN FROM THE INCIDENT LOCATION. THE SAMPLES HAVE BEEN TAKEN FROM MULTIPLE DIFFERENT LOCATIONS AT THE SITE. WHILE REMOVING THE AFFECTED SOIL A CONTRACTOR RESPONDED AND PLACED HEAVY DUTY GARDENING FABRIC TO THE LOCATION. DURING THE PROCESS SAND SOIL AND P-TILE HAVE ALSO BEEN APPLIED TO THE LOCATION. AFTER SEVERAL RAIN EVENTS AT THE LOCATION THIS REMEDIAL ACTION SEEMED TO FAIL.
